PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Dr. Mona Ahmed Yagoub Mohammed

Public Health & Environmental Health Specialist

Multidisciplinary public-health and environmental-health professional with more than 10 years of experience spanning epidemiology, disease prevention, vector control, health promotion, food safety, sanitation, infection prevention, waste management, occupational health and EHS/HSE. Her CV also records food-manufacturing HSE leadership and digital sustainability-governance concepts.
